sentences.text: Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar -LRB- -LSB- sətʃɪn_tɛnˈduːlkər -RSB- born 24 April 1973 -RRB- is a former Indian cricketer and captain , widely regarded as one of the greatest batsmen of all time .	Indian	Indian people	captain	List of India national cricket captains	batsmen	Batting (cricket)

He took up cricket at the age of eleven , made his Test debut on 15 November 1989 against Pakistan in Karachi at the age of sixteen , and went on to represent Mumbai domestically and India internationally for close to twenty-four years .	Mumbai	Mumbai cricket team	Test	Test cricket	cricket	cricket	Pakistan	Pakistan national cricket team	Karachi	Karachi	India	Indian cricket team

He is the only player to have scored one hundred international centuries , the first batsman to score a double century in a One Day International , the holder of the record for the number of runs in both ODI and Test cricket , and the only player to complete more than 30,000 runs in international cricket .	Test	Test cricket	ODI	One Day International	cricket	cricket	scored one hundred international centuries	List of cricketers by number of international centuries scored	double century	Century (cricket)	One Day International	One Day International	international cricket	international cricket

In 2002 , just halfway through his career , Wisden Cricketers ' Almanack ranked him the second greatest Test batsman of all time , behind Don Bradman , and the second greatest ODI batsman of all time , behind Viv Richards .	Test	Test cricket	ODI	One Day International	Don Bradman	Don Bradman	Viv Richards	Viv Richards

Later in his career , Tendulkar was a part of the Indian team that won the 2011 World Cup , his first win in six World Cup appearances for India .	Indian	Indian people	India	Indian cricket team	2011 World Cup	2011 Cricket World Cup	World Cup	Cricket World Cup
He had previously been named `` Player of the Tournament '' at the 2003 edition of the tournament , held in South Africa .	2003 edition of the tournament	2003 Cricket World Cup
In 2013 , he was the only Indian cricketer included in an all-time Test World XI named to mark the 150th anniversary of Wisden Cricketers ' Almanack .	Test	Test cricket	Indian	Indian people

Tendulkar received the Arjuna Award in 1994 for his outstanding sporting achievement , the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna award in 1997 , India 's highest sporting honour , and the Padma Shri and Padma Vibhushan awards in 1999 and 2008 , respectively , India 's fourth and second highest civilian awards .	India	Indian cricket team	Arjuna Award	Arjuna Award	Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna	Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna	Padma Shri	Padma Shri	Padma Vibhushan	Padma Vibhushan

After a few hours of his final match on 16 November 2013 , the Prime Minister 's Office announced the decision to award him the Bharat Ratna , India 's highest civilian award .	India	Indian cricket team	Bharat Ratna	Bharat Ratna
He is the youngest recipient to date and the first ever sportsperson to receive the award .
He also won the 2010 Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy for cricketer of the year at the ICC awards .	Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy	Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy

In 2012 , Tendulkar was nominated to the Rajya Sabha , the upper house of the Parliament of India .	nominated	List of nominated members of Rajya Sabha	India	Indian cricket team	Rajya Sabha	Rajya Sabha	Parliament of India	Parliament of India

He was also the first sportsperson and the first person without an aviation background to be awarded the honorary rank of group captain by the Indian Air Force .	Indian	Indian people	captain	List of India national cricket captains	group captain	group captain	Indian Air Force	Indian Air Force
In 2012 , he was named an Honorary Member of the Order of Australia .	Member of the Order of Australia	Member of the Order of Australia
In December 2012 , Tendulkar announced his retirement from ODIs .

He retired from Twenty20 cricket in October 2013 and subsequently announced his retirement from all forms of cricket , retiring on 16 November 2013 after playing his 200th and final Test match , against the West Indies in Mumbai 's Wankhede Stadium .
